description: This file contains unit test cases for the onboarding flow logic in the Android app, specifically testing the canFinishOnboarding function under different connection states.

classes.name: OnboardingFlowLogicTest
classes.description: Test class for onboarding flow logic that verifies the conditions under which the onboarding can be finished.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyOperatorIsConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding cannot finish when only the operator is connected.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenDisconnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding cannot finish when neither operator nor node is connected.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyNodeIsConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding cannot finish when only the node is connected.

methods.name: allowsFinishOnlyWhenOperatorAndNodeAreConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding can finish when both operator and node are connected.
